answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake bond before its attestations count, and slash it when peers prove its work fraudulent. A long, honest track record becomes a relic no newcomer can forge overnight; reputation sediments like shale, thin layer by thin layer. To spin up a glacier of Sybils, an attacker must lock one bond per identity and risks losing every one to slashing. Cost grows linearly with fake accounts while rewards stay flat, so mass forgery stops paying.
